summary.text: Steven Feldman is the Libertarian Party candidate for North Carolina's 10th Congressional District and a physician and medical scientist who is a professor at Wake Forest University. He was also the Libertarian candidate in the district in 2024, when he received 2.9 percent of the vote. According to his campaign website, he is running to promote individual liberty, reduce federal debt, and support international peace.

paragraphs.text: Steven Feldman has lived in North Carolina for more than 40 years and received his medical training at Duke University and the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, according to his campaign website; WFAE reports he received his M.D. and Ph.D. from Duke University School of Medicine.

WFAE reports he is a professor of dermatology, pathology, and public health sciences at Wake Forest University and a senior advisor at Sensal Health, and he describes himself as having been rated one of the world's leading dermatology experts.
Feldman was the Libertarian nominee for the 10th District in 2024, receiving 2.9 percent (11,614 votes) in a race won by Pat Harrigan.
According to his campaign website, he and his wife, Leora, have been married for 40 years and have two sons.
